intro: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon entrusts an adventurer with delivering a rare Menethil Statuette to the Cathedral of Light. The relic, depicting the late King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, has begun coalescing with holy power. It is handed over to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for permanent safekeeping in Stormwind's spiritual heart.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.
The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
